findings.title: RewardsManager DoS via revertOnIneligible
findings.description: When revertOnIneligible is true, a single ineligible indexer causes the entire takeRewards() transaction to revert, blocking rewards for ALL indexers.
findings.impact: Complete DoS of rewards collection. Single ineligible indexer blocks ALL takeRewards() calls. Accrued rewards locked for all indexers and delegators. Economic damage >$1M possible.
findings.remediation: Replace require with reclaim: if (isIneligible && revertOnIneligible) { _reclaimRewards(INDEXER_INELIGIBLE, rewards, ...); return true; }

findings.title: L1Staking Fund Lock — Delegation Pool Tokens Stuck
findings.description: When transferring all stake to L2, the check only verifies tokensAllocated == 0, not tokensUsed(). Delegation pool tokens are permanently stuck.
findings.impact: Delegation pool tokens permanently stuck on L1. Delegators cannot withdraw their GRT. No recovery mechanism exists.
findings.remediation: Check tokensUsed() instead: require(indexerStake.tokensUsed() == 0, 'tokens still in use');
